evaluation: Blind external vision evaluation for attempts 01-06; owner comparative pass for convergence attempts 07-09.

attempts.name: Lantern Row
attempts.evaluator_note: Warm and readable; depth and NPC story are modest.

attempts.name: Quiet Shrine
attempts.evaluator_note: Good cool depth, but darker and less legible.

attempts.name: Market Turn
attempts.evaluator_note: Story density is present, but depth and focal clarity weaken.

attempts.name: Twin Gables
attempts.evaluator_note: Strongest external score: clear, intentional, deep, and memorable.

attempts.name: Canal Edge
attempts.evaluator_note: Cool separation works, but protagonist contrast and readability suffer.

attempts.name: Gatehouse
attempts.evaluator_note: Balanced and clear; depth is solid though the lane narrows.

attempts.name: Shrine Return
attempts.evaluator_note: Quiet return-state refinement; the right occluder dominates.

attempts.name: Lantern Threshold
attempts.evaluator_note: Owner-selected convergence: warm, readable, open middle lane, clear doorway/NPC beat.

attempts.name: Market Reprise
attempts.evaluator_note: Cleaner market reprise, but still less quiet and legible than the final.
